metadata.note: Assessment report generated in Linux environment

security.title: Incorrect Permission Assignment for Critical Resource
security.description: The product specifies permissions for a security-critical resource in a way that allows that resource to be read or modified by unintended actors.

evidence.explanation: `NotificationService` grants `MessageQueueAccessRights.FullControl` to `Everyone` when creating the queue (`_queue.SetPermissions("Everyone", MessageQueueAccessRights.FullControl)`), allowing broad read/write access to a critical messaging resource.
